shipping.estimate: Delivery area, availability and timing are confirmed by the store in WhatsApp before an order is accepted.

policies.shipping: You can send a Cash on Delivery request through WhatsApp with your address and PIN code. Sending a request does not confirm stock or delivery availability. The store will confirm whether it can deliver to you, the delivery window and the final delivery charge in chat before accepting the order. Charges shown on the website are estimates until confirmed. A one-hour delivery service is not guaranteed. Please pay only for an order you have agreed with the store.
policies.returns: Received a damaged, incorrect or missing item? Contact the store using your order reference and a photo where relevant, and we will review a replacement or refund. Please report issues with fresh or chilled food on delivery, and other items within 7 days. Do not send perishable items back without instructions. This policy does not restrict your rights under applicable consumer law.
policies.privacy: Your basket and saved product IDs are kept in your browser. A confirmed delivery address, optional map pin and prepared WhatsApp requests are kept only in this browser tab. Choosing Open WhatsApp shares the prepared request with WhatsApp; the store receives it after you press Send there. Choosing the email alternative opens a draft in your email app, which you must send yourself. These messages contain the products, quantities, estimated total, name, mobile number, email and delivery address you enter, plus your map pin if selected. You can clear the selected location and remove saved request drafts. If you open the map, tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap; area searches and selected map points are sent to the configured geocoding service. GPS is requested only after you choose Use my location. For orders placed through the hosted order service, addresses and coordinates are protected by your private order access code. Contact sdhanpal778@gmail.com for questions about your personal data.
policies.terms: The WhatsApp checkout prepares an order request. It does not send a message automatically, confirm an order, reserve stock or collect payment. Press Send in WhatsApp and wait for the store to confirm product availability, pack sizes, price, delivery charge and delivery timing before agreeing to an order. Website prices are in Indian rupees and are subject to that confirmation. Product images are representative; packaging and produce may vary. Cash on Delivery is payable only when an accepted order is delivered. Online payments are not currently enabled on the public storefront. Contact sdhanpal778@gmail.com for order questions. No affiliation with product brands is implied.
